text: What happens to your body if you stop sleeping? After twenty-four hours awake, your coordination is about as bad as having a blood alcohol level of zero point one percent. That's over the drink-driving limit in many places. Your brain starts taking microsleeps: tiny naps that last a few seconds, while you still look awake. By day three, many people start to hallucinate, and feel anxious and confused. In nineteen sixty-three, a seventeen-year-old student named Randy Gardner stayed awake for eleven days, for a science fair. He recovered. But don't try it. Sleep is when your brain sorts and saves your memories. What time did you go to bed last night?
